newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell East Siberian oil firm stake in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell East Siberian oil firm stake in Dec.

text.p: Russia will sell 47.02 percent of the East Siberian Oil and Gas Company at a cash auction on December 30, auction organiser Federal Stock Corporation said on Friday.
Foreign investors cannot own more than 25 percent in Vostochno-Sibirskaya Neftegazovaya Kompaniya.
The government will offer 8,047.461 shares with a face value of 20 roubles each at a starting price of 1,400 roubles a share, a corporation statement said.
The sale will be executed in two lots of shares representing 32 percent and 15 percent of the company's authorised capital of 342.27 million roubles.
The East Siberian Oil & Gas company's main units are AO Yeniseineftegaz and Yeniseigeofizika.
The government holds a 38 percent stake in the company, while a total 15 percent stake was sold in 1995 in small lots.
East Siberian has the right to develop the 702.7 million tonne Yurubchensky deposit in Siberia.
